label: Whatever is LORD_3 is LORD_1
paraphrase: Open sense bridge, analyst formulation, unattributed. Whatever causes the being of every other being in act as to being, governs every such being and wills some good of its own to every other intellectual being in act as to being (LORD_3) has dominion over everything else (LORD_1, the primitive Primitives.IsLord: authority to dispose of what is subject to it). It carries what LORD_3 leaves untyped: the passage from causal, directive and benevolent volitional relations to authority. Motivation, not attribution: the natural-law reply to the objection that creation or power alone gives no rightful authority, which ties authority to care for the good of those governed. Strictly weaker than 'Whatever is LORD_2 is LORD_1' (eb6611a5; its antecedent adds the willing conjunct; Control.Controls part 2: a cause and governor of all that wills no good to an existing intellectual creature satisfies this bridge vacuously and falsifies the LORD_2 bridge). It does not say that governance is directed to the good willed, that the being is just or wise beyond having intellect, or that dominion includes a jurisdiction to impose moral obligations on rational creatures.
